title: columnea sanguinea

This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
